messages:
emily_support: flagging a weird one — customer reports admin console shows grant as 'Completed' but no ledger entry and credits not visible in account.
emily_support: cust_id=acct_8y3, grant_id=g-7f8a, attempted at 2026-03-06T14:12Z. UI toast said 'Grant processed' then disappeared. Customer still at 0 credits.
mike_support: can you paste the backoffice action log? did the support console return a 200/202?
emily_support: here's what we saw in the browser console: `POST /admin/grants -> 202 Accepted {"task_id":"t-44c"}`. Backoffice shows action "queued". No follow-up webhook in our trace.
ops-bot: Deploy pipeline notifier: canary/infra-health check OK — no platform-wide errors in the last 24h.
sam_sre: looking into service logs — searching for t-44c and g-7f8a.
sam_sre: quick note: backoffice worker retried grant job twice and then logged `ERROR JobProcessor - commit failed: TimeoutError` around 14:13:08Z. No DB transaction rollback entry.
bella_engineer: that sounds like the grant job may have marked the job as processed without finishing the ledger write. Are we missing an idempotency/write-ahead step?
emily_support: customer says they clicked grant once and waited ~30s. We didn't try re-granting because we worried about double credits.
tara_product: risk of double-grant is real. We need to confirm if the initial job wrote a tombstone or partial record.
sam_sre: I pulled the worker logs: `INFO JobProcessor - job t-44c acked; INFO LedgerWriter - enqueue write g-7f8a; ERROR LedgerWriter - flush failed: connection reset` then `WARN JobProcessor - acked_without_commit`. That last message isn't supposed to happen.
bella_engineer: acked_without_commit is a new guard code path we added in 2026-02 for faster acking. Looks like it can ack before the DB flush on certain MySQL transient errors. Reproducing locally.
emily_support: repro steps from support console (what we did): 1) open acct_8y3 -> Actions -> Grant trial 2) set 1000 tokens -> click Grant 3) see spinner ~10-20s -> toast 'Grant processed' 4) no ledger row at `/internal/ledgers?grant_id=g-7f8a`.
mike_support: customer is asking for immediate remediation. Could we run the reconcile script for g-7f8a?
sam_sre: yes — running `scripts/reconcile_grants --grant g-7f8a` now. Will check for duplicates before applying.
ops-bot: reconcile job queued -> job id r-92b.
sam_sre: reconcile found no ledger entry and no tombstone; will run manual ledger insert with metadata `source=admin-console, triggered_by=emily_support` after team sign-off.
bella_engineer: before we insert, we should capture the original request payload from `t-44c` payload store. Need that to compute idempotency key. If the worker acked early we may lack a persisted payload.
emily_support: I have the UI payload JSON from browser logs, attaching below: `{\n  "grant_id":"g-7f8a",\n  "account":"acct_8y3",\n  "amount":1000,\n  "idempotency_key":"ui-emily-1616"\n}`
tara_product: ok let's do manual ledger write but set `manual=true` and include `reconciled_by=support` flag. Also add a follow-up to fix the ack-before-commit path.
mike_support: customer has accepted manual grant if we confirm no duplicate will happen. Proceed?
sam_sre: proceeding with manual insert now. Will run in read-only dry-run first, then apply.
sam_sre: dry-run shows ledger write would succeed; applying now.
sam_sre: done — inserted ledger row id L-8812, credits updated. Notifying customer.
emily_support: customer confirmed credits visible. They said thank you and will avoid re-clicking for now. :relieved:
bella_engineer: filing a ticket to revert the premature-ack behavior and add end-to-end tracing for t-* jobs. Also going to add a DB transactional flush before ack.
tara_product: please add a post-mortem doc with action items and timeline. Priority P2.
emily_support: thanks all — closing loop with customer and adding notes to ticket.
